articles.title: CBA状元为何近年来被戏称为“没人想当”的头衔？ - Sina Sports
articles.summary: CBA状元为何近年来被戏称为“没人想当”的头衔？ Sina Sports
articles.full_body:
Title: CBA状元为何近年来被戏称为“没人想当”的头衔？

URL Source: https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxNN0ZfLTBRLWZkeXl1dG1KYWVkRWdOTUZlRTFyaWphTmRULVBhbjVZMnJnaEVyUUtwSi1raDhaMEFVWEJpSmJzbjRObmg1TENNRlUtdXA2T1F2ZGs2d3AxSm8zUmFKVW55eVByN19kdThlanZmOHN0S2Q0cUVyTDVCYnRBdjdETnhDckkyOHhXUkJrWlpRaDlF

Published Time: 2026-07-30 06:49:31

Markdown Content:
近年来，CBA选秀状元头衔从昔日的荣耀变成被参选者避之不及的“烫手山芋”，这一转变折射出联赛选秀制度、球队经营与青训体系的深层困境。

一、选秀大会的尴尬：弃权潮与“讽刺性”的状元签

2026年CBA选秀大会共22次弃权，创下2019年之后最高纪录，参选人数也跌至7年最低。

选秀举牌文字从直白的“弃”改为“Thanks”，被球迷看作“皇帝的新衣”，掩盖不了大量顺位被放弃的实质。

球队频繁弃选，导致选秀大会流于形式，甚至有观点认为“选秀没必要办下去了”。

![Image 1](https://k.sinaimg.cn/n/sinakd20260730ac/391/w690h501/20260730/99a0-1aa99320c96d22ee50c0a196a45a01f0.jpg/w700d1q75cms.jpg?by=cms_fixed_width)

![Image 2](https://k.sinaimg.cn/n/sinakd20260730ac/247/w625h422/20260730/6e6d-e3eb895ec56338d7b6d26e1db6169b24.jpg/w700d1q75cms.jpg?by=cms_fixed_width)

二、球队困境：摆烂、欠薪与状元签的贬值

部分弱旅长年摆烂，例如四川男篮单赛季仅赢4场，却拿到状元签，但球队整体实力难以吸引优秀球员。

四川男篮存在欠薪传闻，参选球员普遍不愿成为该队状元，有人直言“没有球员想当状元”。

状元签在弱队手中常被交易，俱乐部坦言“无论选了谁，对双方都可能是‘一场空’”。

三、职业生态：青训断层与选秀球员的生存压力

国内篮球人才断层、青训产出不足早已不是秘密，选秀成为补充渠道却收效有限。

大学生球员为CBA注入新鲜血液，但现有生态下难以真正提升联赛水平。

外援占据大量出场时间和关键球权，本土球员被当作“工具人”，状元在球队中往往难以获得战术地位。

四、制度反思：选秀与联赛定位的错位

CBA模仿NBA设立选秀，但青训体系仍是人才主力来源，选秀权价值远不及NBA。

联赛缺乏淘汰压力和竞争机制，球员进入一线队后容易安于现状，状元头衔无法转化为实际成长动力。

选秀球员和俱乐部之间缺乏适配性，状元签的效果高度依赖选中球队的环境与资源。

五、转机与展望：改革路径

增加外援上场名额，倒逼本土球员在高强度对抗中提升能力，是不少球迷和从业者呼吁的方向。

建立更严格的俱乐部财务监管制度，解决欠薪问题，恢复选秀球员对联赛的信心。

打通选秀与青训的衔接，让更多优秀年轻球员通过选秀进入职业赛场，而非仅依赖内部梯队。

# Boxer Abdul - grandson of dictator - disqualified for headbutt

![Image 1: Aziz Abdul reacts after being disqualified for a headbutt during fight against England's Damar Thomas](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/standard/3840/cpsprodpb/38e2/live/4db18910-8b93-11f1-9e6e-a18e6e88bf61.jpg)Image source, Reuters

Image caption, 

Abdul (centre) was disqualified early in the third round against Thomas (right)

By Matthew Henry

BBC Sport Journalist in Glasgow

*   Published 13 minutes ago 

**Ugandan boxer Aziz Abdul - the grandson of dictator Idi Amin - was disqualified from his fight at the Commonwealth Games after appearing to headbutt his English opponent.**

The 25-year-old was punished after lifting his head into Damar Thomas' chin as the pair grappled in the third round.

Abdul later claimed the judges were against him because he is a "black African".

"When you watch the previous fights of England their boxers create a lot of fouls," he said.

"I land a heavy punch on him, they never count. Instead of counting they deduct me.

"I am black African. He is in homeland."

*   
[Idi Amin's boxer grandson determined to become new King of Scotland](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/boxing/articles/ce8l0661yd7o)

    

    *   Published 1 day ago 

Before the super-heavyweight bout Abdul told the BBC he wanted to become the new 'King of Scotland' - in reference to Amin declaring himself that name in 1976.

After taking power in a coup in 1971, Amin ran a brutal regime during which an estimated half a million people were killed. He was also known as the Butcher of Uganda.

Abdul, who never met his grandfather, was chasing Uganda's first Commonwealth boxing medal since Auckland in 1990 - something which would have been guaranteed had he beaten Thomas.

Instead, he was given warnings in the previous two rounds and was trailing on all of the judges' scorecards.
